# Velora Apparel

> Velora Apparel is a ladies wear manufacturer based in Alindra, Gujarat, India. The company supports OEM, private label, job work, and bulk production for brands, boutiques, resellers, and other apparel businesses.

## Website

- [Homepage](https://www.velora-apparel.store/): Company overview, ladies wear products, manufacturing process, and enquiry/contact information.
- [Gujarati](https://www.velora-apparel.store/gu/): Gujarati-language version of the website.
- [Hindi](https://www.velora-apparel.store/hi/): Hindi-language version of the website.
- [German](https://www.velora-apparel.store/de/): German-language version of the website.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.velora-apparel.store/privacy.html): Privacy and third-party resource information.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.velora-apparel.store/terms.html): Website terms and service information.

## Products

Velora Apparel manufactures ladies wear including:

- Kurtis
- Co-ord sets
- Tops
- Office wear
- Night wear
- Dresses

## Services

- OEM manufacturing: production to the client's design, tech pack or reference sample, with sampling and quality checks before bulk production.
- Private label manufacturing: garments produced and packed under the client's own brand label, for retail or online selling.
- Job work stitching: the client supplies fabric; Velora Apparel handles cutting, stitching, quality checking and packing.
- Bulk production: repeat and bulk orders with consistent sizing and retail-ready finishing.
- Sampling and product development: fabric, fit and finishing are agreed on an approved sample before bulk production.

## Manufacturing

The stated production flow is:

1. Consultation
2. Sampling
3. Fabric selection
4. Cutting
5. Stitching
6. Quality checking
7. Packing
8. Delivery

The company focuses on clean stitching, practical timelines, consistent sizing, and retail-ready finishing.

## Customers

The website is intended for brands, boutiques, resellers, private labels, and businesses requiring ladies wear production.

## Frequently asked questions

- What does Velora Apparel manufacture? Ladies wear: kurtis, co-ord sets, tops, office wear, night wear and dresses, for brands, boutiques, resellers and private labels.
- Does Velora Apparel offer OEM and private label manufacturing? Yes. It offers OEM manufacturing, private label manufacturing, job work and bulk production.
- Where is Velora Apparel located? In the village of Alindra, Gujarat, India.
- What information is needed for a quote? Product category, target quantity, fabric preference, size range and delivery timeline.
- What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ)? It depends on product, fabric and design; Velora Apparel confirms it per order based on the target quantity per design.
- How long does production take? It depends on quantity, fabric availability and design; bulk production starts after sample approval and the delivery timeline is agreed in advance.
- Can clients supply their own fabric? Yes, through job work.
- Does Velora Apparel work with boutiques and new brands? Yes: boutiques, resellers, private label brands and established brands.
- How do I contact Velora Apparel? Phone or WhatsApp +91 79909 65209, or email rajani.parmar.tailor@gmail.com.

## Napkins and cleaning cloths

Velora Apparel also makes napkins and cleaning cloths.

- [Products](https://www.velora-apparel.store/products/): Kitchen napkins and towels, microfiber car cleaning cloths, office napkins and desk cloths, multipurpose cleaning cloths. Also in [Gujarati](https://www.velora-apparel.store/gu/products/), [Hindi](https://www.velora-apparel.store/hi/products/) and [German](https://www.velora-apparel.store/de/products/).

Tailoring: new clothes stitched to the customer's measurements for ladies (kurti, salwar suit, blouse, dress, co-ord set, lehenga), gents (shirt, trousers, kurta, kurta pyjama), kids (frock, shirt, trousers, kurta, school uniform) and others (work uniforms, curtains, cushion covers). Enquiries are sent from the Tailoring section of the Products page on WhatsApp; Velora Apparel replies with stitching charges and delivery time.

Materials: cotton, terry cotton, waffle cotton, microfiber. Multiple colours and sizes, in packs of 3, 6 or 12. Ordering: add items to the cart on the Products page and send the order on WhatsApp (+91 79909 65209), retail or wholesale. Listings on Meesho, Amazon, Flipkart, JioMart and IndiaMART are coming soon. Custom sizes, colours and private label packaging are available for bulk orders on request.
